collector.name: MBO Discovery Collector
notes: No POST, PUT, or DELETE API calls are used.
Record attachment binary contents are NOT downloaded.
Uploaded JavaScript/CSS customization source files are read with GET when possible.
Record data is limited to records visible to the currently signed-in user.
File keys inside exported record/settings data are removed from the final export.
